verdict_text: NO. The plan casts only three of the four projection families per layer (36 tensors), omitting `h.<i>.attn.c_proj.weight`, so it violates Required result 1 (exactly 48 projection matrices cast to bfloat16) and leaves the 12 attention output projections in float32. Consequently the required check "exactly 48 tensors are bfloat16" is not implemented; the plan instead asserts a count of 36 and its dtype checks are built around the 36-tensor pattern, contradicting the Required checks clause. The delete, float32 upcast, 148-tensor count, and 64 MiB sharding are otherwise consistent with the spec, but the missing `attn.c_proj.weight` cast makes the output dtype set wrong against the hidden reference.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
